title: הֲ
content: הֲ interrog. part. (BH הֲ, q. v.: Targum הֲ; not Syr.: on the vocal., v. K§ 67, 2);—Dn 2:26 הַאִיתָיח art thou … ? 3:14 הַצְדָּא (Baer Gi; edd. הַחְדָא), 6:21 הַיְכִל can he … ? הֲלָא nonne ? † 3:24, 4:27, 6:18.

title: הָא
content: [Str1888,1887] † הָא demonstr. part. lo ! behold ! (BH הֵא (twice); Eg. Aram. and Têma הא (Cooke193, 198); Targum הָא; Syr. ܗܐ; Mand. הא (NöM 81); Ar. هَاء in Aram. also oft. prefixed to pr. 3 ps. for greater definiteness, as Targum הָהוּא, ܗܘ (for hā-hū), v. NöM 89 f. WCG 106 f.), Dn 3:25.

title: הֵא
content: [Str1888,1887–88,1983] † הֵא demonstr. part., prefixed idiom. to כְּ for greater definiteness, lit. behold like (BH הֵא, v. הָא supr.), only in הֵא־כְּדִי Dn 2:43 הֵא־כְּדִי פַרְזְלָא לָא מִתְעָרַב l1 Ke as iron doth not mingle with clay (cf. a. Targumo הָא כְמַיָּא Gn 49:4, so TargumJon ´הא כ: Is 5:28, 9:4 + oft.; TargumJer ´הֵי כ: Gn 26:4, 26:18, 26:22 + oft.; הֵיח Psalm 2:9, 5:10, 5:13 +, also pleon. ´הֵיח כְּ: Psalm 22:14, 22:15, 22:17 + oft. b. Palm. הֵיח as (Lzb259), as היך בנמוסא as (is) in the law (Cooke321; so TargumJer Psalm 2:9, etc.), הֵיח דִּי conj. (like Dn הֵא כְּדִי: = Heb. כַּאֲשֶׁר), as היך די גבא like as he levied, CookeTariff ii. b 12. 18, c 14. 17. 21. 26 [Targumo Jon for כַּאֲשֶׁר have ´כְּמָא דְ:, TargumJer ´הֵיכְמָא דְ:, SyrVer. ܐܝܟ ܕ]. It is dub. whether הֵא כְּדִי belongs to a (notice esp. TargumJon) or b: SchulthZAW 1902, 164 f. to b. reading הֵאח דִּי (but א rare and late: D:(2) § 45. 1); NesOLtz. 1892, 488 from הֵיח (v. BH) how ?).

title: הַדָּבַר
content: [Str1907,1411] ‡ † [הַדָּבַר] n.m. counsellor, minister (Pers. loan-word; orig. form and mng. dub., cf. AndrM 60* MeyEntst. J. 23 Dr:Dn 3:24);—pl. emph. הַדָּֽבְרַיָּא Dn 6:8; cstr. הַדָּֽבְרֵי 3:27; sf. הַדָּֽבְרַי 4:33, ר֫וֺהִי- 3:24.—Vid. גְּדָֽבְרַיָּא. p. 1086

title: הַדָּם
content: [Str1917] † [הַדָּם] n.[m.] member, limb (loan-word from Pers. هَنْدَام, أَندَام id. LagGes. Abh. 28 FlLevy Ch WB i. 423 b); pl. abs. הַדָּמִין תִּתְעַבְדוּן Dn 2:5 ye shall be made members, i.e. dismembered, so 3:29.

title: הֲדַר
content:
[Str1921–22] † [הֲדַר] vb. Pa. glorify God (Targum Syr. BH honour man);—Impf. 2 ms. הַדַָּרְתָּ Dn 5:23, 1 s. הַדְּרֵת 4:31; Pt. act. מְהַדַּר v:34 (all c. ל Pers.).

[Str1923] † [הֲדַר] n. [m.] honour, majesty, of kg.;—emph. הַדְרָא Dn 5:18; sf. הַדְרִי 4:27, 4:33 (where Behrm plausibly (after Theod.) הַדְרֵת [Targum הֲדַר return]).

title: הֲוָא
content: [Str1934,1961] הֲוָא, הֲוָּה:71 vb. come to pass, become, be (BH הָיָה);—Pe. Pf. 3 ms. הֲוָה Dn 4:26 +, הֲוָא Dn 5:19 +; 2 ms. הֲוַיְתָ Dn 2:31, 2:34, 1 s. הֲוֵית 4:1 +; 3 mpl. הֲווֺ Dn 2:35 +; Impf. 3 ms. לֶהֱוֵא (K§ 47, 1) b) Dr§ 204 Obs. NöM 215 ff.; in JAram. as jussive D§ 61, 1 c) Dn 2:20 +; 3 fs. תֶּהֱוֵה Dn 4:24 +, אֵ֯ Ezr 6:8 +, 3 mpl. לֶהֱוֺן Ezr 6:10 + 6 t., 3 fpl. לֶהֶוְיָן Dn 5:17; Imv. mpl. הֱווֺ Ezr 4:22, הֲזוֺ 6:6;—1. come to pass Dn 2:28, 2:29, 2:29, 2:45. 2. come into being, arise Ezr 7:23; become, come to be, c. n. pred. Dn 4:24, 5:29 and ( = represent) 7:23; c. כְּ like 2:35 a, c. ל pred. v:35 b, c. adj. pred. Ezr 6:6, c. adv. phr. 5:5, Dn 4:22; oft. periphrast., c. pt.: ´יְדִיעַ לה: let become known 3:18, Ezr 4:12, 4:13, 5:8; let it be given 6:8, 6:9, also 7:26, Dn 2:20. 3. be, as copula, c. adj. pred. Dn 2:40, 2:42, 7:19; so very often in periphrast. conj. c. pt., צָבֵא ´ה: wish 5:19, 5:19, 5:19, 5:19, ´חָזֵה ה: behold 2:31, 2:34, 7:2, 7:4, 7:6 +, etc.

title: הוּא
content:
[Str1932,1931] † הוּא:14 m. הִיא:7 f. pron. of 3 s. he, she, it (= BH הוּא, הִיא; Zinj. and Palm. (once) הא, Palm. (usually) Nab. Eg. Aram. הו, f. ´ה:, Lzb257, S-CPap. A 1, 12+; A 4, C 9 +. The pl. is אִנּוּן, q.v.);—he, she, it, Dn 2:21 …וְהוּא מְהַשְׁנֵא: and he will change, etc., v:22, v:44, 6:5, 7:7, 7:24, Ezr 5:8; Dn 2:32 הוּא צַלְמָא that image (nom. pend.); 4:19 אַנְתָּה הוּא thou art it. Resuming the subj. with emph. (BH 2 b) 2:47, 6:17; resuming the subj. in predication (ib. 3 b) 2:20 חָכְמְתָא וּגְבוּרְתָּא דִּי־לֵהּ הִיא it is his, v:28. Anticipating the subj. (ib. 4 a) 2:9 חֲדָא הִיא דָֽתְכוֺן; with a pron. (ib. 4 b) 2:38 …אַנְתְּה הוּא: thou art the head of gold 5:13; 3:15 …מָן הוּא אֱלָהּ: who is the god … ? (so pl. אִנּוּן Ezr 5:4); 4:27 …הֲלָא דָא הִיא: (ib. 4 b γ); 6:27 …דִּי הוּא: who is … (ib. 2 c), Ezr 6:15 (so …דִּי אִנוּן: Dn 7:17). [Cf. in Targum Ex 14:25, 15:11, 2 S 20:19, 24:17, Psalm 43:2, 63:4, 66:3 +.] Affirming existence (BH 6 b) Dn 4:21. Cf. Dr: §§ 198–201, K§ 87, 3.

[Str1965,1964,4415] † [הֵיכַל] n.m. palace, temple (As. loan-word; BH; also Palm. היכלא and הכלא Lzb259 SAC43);—emph. הֵיכְלָא Ezr 4:14 +; cstr. הֵיכַל Dn 4:26; sf. הֵיכְּ לִי 4:1, לֵהּ- 6:19;—1. place of king Dn 4:1, 4:26, 5:5, 6:19, Ezr 4:14 (v. מְלַח). 2. temple: a. in Jerusalem Dn 5:2, 5:3, Ezr 5:14 a, 5:15, 6:5, 6:5. b. in Babylon 5:14 b, 5:14 c.

title: הֲלַךְ
content:
[Str1946,1981] † [הֲלַךְ] vb. go (BH; Targum; Syr. only Pa.);—Pe. syncop. (so Targum D§ 70, 9, Eg. Aram. Cooke209, Impf. S-CD 22, G 25, 28) go, of men: Impf. 3 ms. וִיהַח (K§ 44 a; al. וִיהָח) Ezr 6:5, יְהָךְ 5:5; of inanimate things = be brought, 7:13; Inf. לִמְהַח (Kl. c.; al. חָ֯) v:13. Pa. Pt. מְהַלֵח walking about Dn 4:26 (עַלloc.). Haph. id.: Pt. pl. מַהְלְכִין 3:25 (בְּגוֺא); fig. 4:34 walk in pride (? rd. Pa. in these).

[Str1983] † הֲלָךְ (K§ 57 a)) n.[m.] toll;—Ezr 4:13, 4:20, 7:24.

title: הִמּוֺ
content:
[Str1994,1992] † הִמּוֺ:9 (Ezr), הִמּוֺן:3 (Dn), Pron. 3 pl. they, them (= BH הֵם, הֵמָּה, q.v., but the more original forms. Eg. Aram. המו CIS145 B 4 (Cooke207),:149 A 1, S-CPap. C 7, 10 +; not Targum Syr., which use אִנּוּן ܐܶܢܽܘܢ, ܗܶܢܽܘܢ, instead; Ar. هُمُ, هُمْ. The n in הִמּוֺן, as in דֵּין, אִלֵּין, by the side of זֶה, אֵלֶּה, أُولَآءِ; NöM 86 WCG 106);—they, them: a. as nom. Ezr 5:11 אֲבַחְנָא הִמּוֺ עַבְדוֺהִי we are his servants (constr. as in Syr., Nö§ 312 D Mt 5:13, K§ 87. 3). b. as accus. (in BAram., as in Syr., there being no verbal sf. of 3 pl.; so Eg. Aram. Cooke76 B 4, S-CPap. E 5 +), Dn 2:34 והדקת הִמּוֺ and crushed them, v:35, 3:22, Ezr 4:10, 4:23, 5:5, 5:12, 5:14, 5:14, 5:15, 7:17.—Comp. אִנּוּן.

[Str2002] † הַמְנִיכָא Qr (Kt המינכָא, also [Gi] המוניכא, etc.) n.[m.] chain, necklace (Talm. הַמְנִכָּא DWB 108; Syr. ܗܡܢܝܟܐ; loan-word from Gk. μανιάκης K§ 64, 4; or < Pers. hämyān, girdle [dimin. would behamyānak] (whence also Gk. μαν., Bev Dr:Dn 5:7) AndrM 60* (rdg. הַמְיָנְֽכָא); v. also Behrmix LagGes. Abh. 40; Arm. Stud. 1420; v. Krauss 5 f. (who cp. also Talm. מוּנְיָיק, מָנְיָיק necklace, bracelet, LevyNHWB iii. 52 b, 158 b D230));—of gold, Dn 5:7, 5:16, 5:29.

title: הֵן
content:
[Str2005–06,518,3861] † הֵן conj. if, whether (BH. הֵן, q.v.: Zenj. Eg. Aram. (S-CPap. A 7 +), Palm. Nab. הן, Mand. הין if [TargumOJon use אם, TargumJer אין, Syr. ܐܶܢ]);—1. if, Dn 2:6, 3:15, 3:17, 4:24, 5:16, Ezr 4:13, 4:16, 5:17, …הֵן לָא: Dn 2:5, 2:9, 3:15; v:18 הֵן לָ֔א if not. 2. repeated, הֵן…הֵן: sive ... sive, whether ... or (cf. BH אִם, 1 b 1), Ezr 7:26 (so Palm.:Tariff ii. c. 19). 3. in indirect question, whether (cf. אִם, 2 b), Ezr 5:17 b …הֵן אִיתַי:…יִתְבַּקַּר:.—Vid. also לָהֵן. p. 50, 243, 1099

הִסִּק etc., v. סלק Haph.

title: הרהר
content:
הרהר (check of foll., Targum הַרְהֵר, NH הִרְהֵר reflect, brood impurely DWB 112; Syr. ܗܪܗܪ is injure, irritate, quarrel PS).

[Str2031] † [הַרְהֹר] n.[m.] fancy, imagining;—pl. abs. הַרְהֹרִין Dn 4:2 fancies (in dream).
